01: Humfiverse is built by Cesare Marzo, a legal advisor working on European digital regulation: Meeka, eIDAS, and intellectual property, previously at the European Union Intellectual Property Office. Together with a co-founder, the team is building the funding layer that independent music never had.
02: In 2024, eight point two million self-releasing artists earned two billion dollars. But to make a record, they need money up front. A label will pay, and take ownership. Crowdfunding asks fans to trust a middleman with the money. In 2019, PledgeMusic collapsed, owing artists an estimated one to three million dollars, and the receiver said refunds were unlikely.
03: Humfiverse takes the middleman out of the money. An artist launches a campaign together with a recording studio. Fans contribute in U.S.D.C., into an escrow on Ethereum that holds only that campaign's funds. Each tranche is released only when both the artist and the studio confirm the milestone. Not us. If a campaign is cancelled, supporters are refunded from what's left. Once the music is out, the catalogue lives on-chain as a token, and royalty income deposited to it is claimed by each holder, from their own wallet.
04: Why now? Stablecoins let a fan anywhere back an artist with a few dollars. Smart contracts turn "we'll pay the studio" into a rule. And Europe's crowdfunding regulation and Meeka finally give a clear legal path to do it properly.
05: And it works today. Humfiverse is live on the Sepolia test net: launch a campaign, fund it, confirm milestones and release the money, end to end, in nine languages, with email or Google sign-in. Three contracts, a hundred and fifteen automated tests, a two-of-three multi-sig as owner, and all of it open source.
06: The business is simple: we earn when value moves. Two percent on contributions, three percent on each released tranche, six percent on direct catalogue sales, and one percent on resales and royalty distribution. We go artists first: founding artists one by one, and recording studios as partners, because each studio brings dozens of artists with it.
07: Next: an external audit, a pilot through a licensed European partner, then main net. Humfiverse. Music, funded transparently, and verifiable by everyone.
